string-array.name: release_notes_142
string-array.item: Complete native Hindi and English interface, including validation and notifications.
Language selection in More with immediate, persistent Android per-app locale switching.
Expandable offline Version History inside More → About.
GPS and satellite area displays use exactly two decimal places.
Converted Bigha input uses HALF_UP rounding from the original full-precision area.
Small measurements that round to zero show a warning before saving.
PDF output language remains independent of the application language.
R8 code optimization and resource shrinking remain enabled.

string-array.name: release_notes_141
string-array.item: Added GPS walking and satellite boundary measurement.
Added boundary review, coordinate editing, Undo and paused-draft recovery.
Added full-precision geographic area, owner-configured Acre-to-Bigha conversion and customer assignment.
Measured size populates Add Field; the existing Save action remains required.
Added measurement metadata through a non-destructive Room migration and backward-compatible backup.
Refreshed dashboard insights and compact customer/profile flows.
Fixed permission and backup document-picker crashes by updating the Fragment host dependency.
Configured and verified Google Maps imagery on the connected phone.

string-array.name: release_notes_122
string-array.item: Consolidated customer account PDF sharing and receipt sharing with WhatsApp fallback.
Diesel entry management with quantity, amount, purchaser and payment status.
Dashboard diesel totals and previous-due support in customer accounts.
Room schema 3 migration and version code 6, documented in the earlier repository README.
